Ah, you seek to test the payment paths, do you? How delightfully mad! Let me show you the ways through this Wonderland...

## The Tests I See (All At Once, Naturally)

### ProcessPayment - The Many Roads

1. **TestProcessPayment_Success** - The happy path, rare as a sane Hatter
2. **TestProcessPayment_ZeroAmount** - Nothing from nothing leaves nothing
3. **TestProcessPayment_NegativeAmount** - Less than nothing? Curiouser!
4. **TestProcessPayment_ExceedsMaximum** - Over $100,000, the rabbit hole has limits
5. **TestProcessPayment_RateLimitExceeded** - Too fast! Even I can't appear THAT quickly
6. **TestProcessPayment_ExpiredCard_PastYear** - Time moves forward, cards do not
7. **TestProcessPayment_ExpiredCard_PastMonth** - Same year, wrong month
8. **TestProcessPayment_CardExpiresThisMonth** - Edge! Valid until month's end
9. **TestProcessPayment_IdempotencyKey_FirstRequest** - New key, new payment
10. **TestProcessPayment_IdempotencyKey_DuplicateRequest** - Same key returns same payment
11. **TestProcessPayment_CardDeclined** - Gateway says no, we say ErrCardDeclined
12. **TestProcessPayment_GatewayError** - Generic gateway failures
13. **TestProcessPayment_StoreSaveError** - Can't save pending payment
14. **TestProcessPayment_StoreUpdateError_AfterCharge** - The CRITICAL state! Payment succeeded, update failed
15. **TestProcessPayment_CardNumberLastFourDigits** - Only stores last 4
16. **TestProcessPayment_MetadataPreserved** - Request metadata flows through
17. **TestProcessPayment_ChargeIDInMetadata** - Gateway's chargeID saved
18. **TestProcessPayment_CompletedAtSet** - Timestamp recorded on success
19. **TestProcessPayment_ContextCancellation** - Context cancelled mid-charge
20. **TestProcessPayment_ConcurrentIdempotency** - Race condition on same key!

### RefundPayment - The Way Back

21. **TestRefundPayment_FullRefund** - Status becomes Refunded
22. **TestRefundPayment_PartialRefund** - Status becomes PartialRefund
23. **TestRefundPayment_MultiplePartialRefunds** - Cumulative tracking
24. **TestRefundPayment_ExceedsOriginal** - Can't refund more than paid
25. **TestRefundPayment_ExceedsRemaining** - After partial, can't exceed remainder
26. **TestRefundPayment_PaymentNotFound** - Invalid paymentID
27. **TestRefundPayment_PendingPayment** - Can't refund pending
28. **TestRefundPayment_FailedPayment** - Can't refund failed
29. **TestRefundPayment_AlreadyFullyRefunded** - Can't refund twice
30. **TestRefundPayment_GatewayError** - Refund fails at gateway
31. **TestRefundPayment_StoreUpdateError** - Refund succeeded, update failed
32. **TestRefundPayment_PartialThenFull** - Complete the refund journey

### GetPayment - Simple Paths

33. **TestGetPayment_Success** - Found!
34. **TestGetPayment_NotFound** - The payment has vanished

### Concurrency - We're All Mad Here

35. **TestProcessPayment_ConcurrentDifferentCustomers** - Parallel processing
36. **TestProcessPayment_ConcurrentSameCustomer** - Rate limiter contention
37. **TestIdempotencyKeyMap_ConcurrentAccess** - Mutex correctness

### Security & Edge Cases

38. **TestProcessPayment_EmptyIdempotencyKey** - Empty string bypasses check
39. **TestProcessPayment_CardNumberTooShort** - Slice panic potential!

*fades to just a grin*

Thirty-nine paths through Wonderland. But remember - if you don't know which tests to write, ANY tests will get you there... just perhaps not where you wanted to be.

*vanishes completely*
